pages.title: Big Cannons
pages.text: Create Big Cannons adds artillery built as contraptions: cast or built-up barrels, breeches, mounts, loaders and munitions. [#](2E5AAC)[Ponder](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() explains each step; this page only covers what connects to the rest of the pack.

pages.title: Cannon Mount
pages.text: The rotating base that aims a cannon. Cannons are [#](7A3C9A)[assembled](entry://glossary/assemble)[#]() onto it as a contraption.

pages.title: Cannon Loader
pages.text: A contraption part that pushes charges and shells in. Cartridges and powder charges set range, shells set effect.

pages.title: Basin Foundry Lid
pages.text: Melts bronze, cast iron and nethersteel in a [#](2E5AAC)[heated basin](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() for casting cannon parts.

[#](2E5AAC)[TFMG](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#]() ties in:
- Its **Casting Basin** casts Big Cannons bronze, cast iron and nethersteel.
- Its vat with graphite electrodes turns netherite scrap and molten steel into nethersteel.

pages.title: Steel and bronze
pages.text:
- **Steel:** Big Cannons' own steel recipes (mixing iron and coal, compacting molten steel) now give [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG steel](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#]().
- **Bronze** comes from [#](2E5AAC)[Alloyed](entry://industry/alloyed)[#]()'s mixer recipe (Big Cannons' cheaper bronze mixes are off).
- Old Big Cannons steel and bronze convert in a crafting grid.

See [#](2E5AAC)[Shared Metals](entry://materials/shared_metals)[#]().

Cannons are built from contraptions: [#](2E5AAC)[Contraptions](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#](), so you can mount them on moving builds.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** handle with care, shells destroy blocks.
